help.usage:
argvus removable-devices {VERSION} — Removable storage module for Waybar (UDisks2)

Usage: argvus removable-devices [options] <command> [device]

Commands:
  watch         emit a JSON line for Waybar whenever devices change (default)
  once          emit a single JSON line and exit
  list          print removable storage devices
  devices       choose a device and open it in the file manager
  menu          interactive context menu (GUI or rofi)
  open          open the device, mounting it first if necessary
  mount         Mount this device
  unmount       Unmount this device
  eject         Unmount and eject this device
  poweroff      Safely power off this drive
  lock          Lock this encrypted volume
  unlock        Unlock this encrypted volume
  copy          Copy the mount path

[device] selects a block node (/dev/sdb1), label, name or object path; the first device is used when omitted.

Options:
  --config <path>       use an explicit configuration file
  --x <px>              set the menu X position (GUI)
  --y <px>              set the menu Y position (GUI)
  --bar-bottom <px>     bottom edge of the Waybar surface (GUI)
  -h, --help            show this help
  -v, --version         print the version
